# Runwaize documentation

> Supervaize Studio operates AI agents: missions, jobs, cases, steps, human in the loop, guardrails and costs. The Supervaizer SDK (Python) connects an agent to Studio.

To connect a Python agent to Studio, use the Supervaizer integration skill. It interviews the developer, then builds and tests the controller from the guides below.

- Skill instructions: https://github.com/supervaize/supervaizer/blob/main/skills/supervaizer-integration/SKILL.md
- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add supervaize/supervaizer`, then `/plugin install supervaizer-integration@supervaizer`
- Other coding agents: `git clone https://github.com/supervaize/supervaizer.git` and read `skills/supervaizer-integration/SKILL.md`
- Complete example agent: https://github.com/supervaize/supervaize_hello_world

## Supervaizer Controller guides

- [Integration skill](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/integrations/skills/supervaizer-integration): install, prompts, what the skill builds
- [Quickstart](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/quickstart): install, `supervaizer login`, start, check
- [Missions, jobs, cases and steps](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/core-concepts): the mapping to decide first
- [Build your controller](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/controller-setup): registration, start form, job state, field definitions
- [Parameters and secrets](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/parameters): workspace settings
- [Human in the loop](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/human-in-the-loop): steps that wait for a person
- [Shared resources](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/resources): data that several jobs use
- [Cost reporting](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/cost-reporting): step and job costs
- [Guardrail controls](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/rule-checkpoints): rule checkpoints that allow, pause or stop a step
- [Configure screen](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/job-configurator): setup on the job page
- [Analytics](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/job-analytics): job and mission dashboards
- [Tunnel for local development](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/tunneling-setup)
- [Cloud deployment](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/deploy): `supervaizer deploy`
- [Network security](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/network-security)
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.runwaize.com/docs/supervaizer-controller/troubleshooting): registration and authorization errors
